issues.detail: The Hebrew 'הַגָּד' (the Gad) refers to the tribe/region of Gad, not a river named 'Ga-đi'. The Vietnamese 'dòng sông Ga-đi' (river of Gadi) mistranslates this as a river name, changing the meaning.

The Hebrew 'וְאֶל יַעְזֵר' means 'and toward Jazer' (a place name). The Vietnamese 'và hướng về Ja-xe' is acceptable, but the transliteration 'Ja-xe' is not standard; however, the main issue is the 'Ga-đi' error.
